file.reasoning: Tests exercise a synthetic package.json dependency scanner that detects the absence of APM and error-tracking packages, demonstrating how missing observability silently loses errors versus the safe fix of adding Sentry and OpenTelemetry.

Tests simulate the absence of any telemetry layer (foot-gun) versus a minimal analytics shim that captures the five key lifecycle events recommended by the finding, verifying events are recorded, attributed to users, and carry the correct properties.

Tests demonstrate that an unprotected auth handler allows unlimited brute-force attempts, while the safe fix enforces per-IP rate limiting (5/min) and account locking after 10 failures, blocking further attempts even with correct credentials.
